subject: SHARING clause
notes: Format: SHARING [WITH] { ALL [OTHER] | NO [OTHER] | READ ONLY } — SHARING/ALL/NO/READ/ONLY underlined, WITH/OTHER optional (cite.py --check 12.4.5.15.2 "SHARING" OK). Grammar sharingClause = SHARING WITH? sharingMode; sharingMode = ALL OTHER? | NO OTHER? | READ ONLY — exact match, one of three required. Probe (pinned cobol.exe, out/probe/sharing-clause/p1.cob, --std 2023 and 2002): `SHARING NO.`, `SHARING READ ONLY`, `SHARING WITH ALL`, `SHARING WITH NO OTHER` all accepted and bound to the right modes (runtime statuses per Table 19: 61/00/61/...). n1.cob: `SHARING WITH READ.` (no ONLY) rejected COBOL0312; `SHARING WITH OTHER.` rejected (COBOL2072 — correct rejection, but its message text talks about WHEN OTHER/§5.2.6.2, a misleading diagnostic, not a conformance defect). --std 85: COBOL0900 on every SHARING clause (edition gate, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitSharingClause; also conformance:cases/_unassigned/sharing_below_2002). Covering golden pb321_table19_open_arbitration writes all three alternatives (with WITH/OTHER spelled); the optional-word omissions are verified by probe only. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (a COBOL-2002 introduction; absent from COBOL-85 — rejected there)]
